powers: You may discard a card to add 1 die to your check (☐ or a check by another character at your location) to acquire a weapon, an armor, or an item.

You may display a card to gain all skills listed on the check to acquire for that card equal to your Intelligence skill until the end of the turn. (☐ You may also add any of that card's traits to your checks during this turn.) At the end of the turn, recharge the displayed cards.

roles.name: Acquisitor
powers: You may discard (☐ or recharge) a card to add 1 die to your check (☐ or a check by another character at your location) to acquire a weapon, an armor, or an item.

You may display a card to gain all the skills listed on the check to acquire that card equal to your Intelligence skill until the end of your turn. (☐ You may also add any of that card's traits to your checks during this turn.) At the end of the turn, recharge the displayed cards.
☐ After you acquire a weapon, an armor, or an item on the first exploration of your turn (☐ or any exploration), you may discard a card to explore your location.
☐ Before you reset your hand, you may set aside any number of items; return them to your hand after you reset it.
☐ On your Intelligence check, after the roll, you may bury (☐ or discard) a weapon, an armor, or an item to add or subtract 3.

roles.name: Channeler
powers: You may discard a card to add 1 die to your check (☐ or a check by another character at your location) to acquire a weapon, an armor, or an item (☐ or a spell).

You may display a card to gain all the skills listed on the check to acquire that card equal to your Intelligence skill until the end of your turn. (☐ You may also add any of that card's traits to your checks during this turn.) At the end of the turn, recharge the displayed cards (☐ then you may shuffle your deck).

☐ During your encounter with a bane, you may recharge a weapon, an armor, or an item that has the Magic trait to summon and play a random spell that has the Attack trait and an adventure deck number less than that of the current scenario (☐ and shares a trait of your choice with the card you are recharging).
☐ You gain the skill Arcane: Intelligence +1 (☐ and the skill Divine: Intelligence +1).
☐ On your Intelligence check, after the roll, you may discard an item to reroll the dice; take the new result.
